branding.heading: Branding
branding.hideNameHint: Enable if your logo already contains the institute name. Hides the name in the sidebar and login page.
branding.stackNameHint: Render the institute name centered underneath the logo instead of beside it, in the sidebar header.
branding.logoWidthHint: Leave blank to use default. Set 250+ AND clear the height to make the sidebar logo span the full width, edge to edge.
branding.logoHeightHint: Leave blank to scale proportionally to the width (required for a full-width sidebar logo). Set a value to fit the logo inside a fixed box instead.

phone.heading: Phone Input Preferences
phone.preferredCountriesHint: The first selected country is pre-selected in phone inputs across the learner and admin portals. The full list determines the order of the country picker. Use the ↑ / ↓ arrows on each chip to reorder.
phone.geoModeLabel: When a form is opened abroad
phone.geoModePreview: You are in {{detected}}. With these settings a phone field on this portal would start on {{resolved}}. Add ?phoneCountry=ru to any form URL to preview another country.
phone.geoModePreviewUnknown: Your region could not be detected from this browser, so the fallback applies: a phone field on this portal would start on {{resolved}}.

INSTITUTE_FIRST.label: Preferred countries win
INSTITUTE_FIRST.hint: The list above decides. The country a form is opened from is used only if you have selected no preferred countries — so a form opened in Russia starts on +7 rather than defaulting to India.

GEO_FIRST.label: Follow the visitor's country
GEO_FIRST.hint: The country a form is opened from is pre-selected; your preferred countries still order the rest of the picker. Best when you take enrolments from several countries.

INSTITUTE_ONLY.label: Preferred countries only
INSTITUTE_ONLY.hint: Never look at where a form is opened from. Choose this if every phone number you collect belongs to one country.
